description.p: @@NAME_LONG@@ is a code editor derived from Code - OSS, the open-source core of Visual Studio Code, with every built-in AI surface, telemetry hook and account prompt removed.

It keeps what makes the editor good: fast editing, IntelliSense, an integrated terminal, source control and debugging. There is no chat panel, no agent, no sign-in, and nothing reports back. Extensions install from Open VSX.
